troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting: Coolant Pressure Low (Alarm 700016)
troubleshooting.shortdesc: Diagnose and resolve MC-5000 alarm 700016, which indicates coolant pressure has dropped below the 0.3 MPa threshold.

condition.p: Alarm code 700016 is displayed on the SINUMERIK ONE HMI. The coolant pressure reading on the diagnostics screen is below 0.3 MPa (normal operating range: 0.4–0.6 MPa).
The machine will halt spindle rotation and cutting operations automatically until pressure is restored.

cause.p: Probable cause (80%): Coolant return filter is clogged with chips or debris from normal machining operations.

remedy.cmd: Perform LOTO on the coolant pump circuit.
Open the coolant tank hatch at the rear of the machine (Zone 4 — requires key-lock reset after closing).
Remove the return filter element (P/N: F-0800-01) and inspect.
remedy.info: If the filter element is visibly clogged with chips or sludge, proceed to clean it. If the element is damaged, replace it with a new one (P/N: F-0800-01-R). See Coolant Filter Replacement Task (create this topic in the same directory).

remedy.cmd: Reassemble the filter housing, close the hatch (key-lock engage), remove LOTO, and restart the coolant pump from the HMI.
remedy.stepresult: Verify in HMI Diagnostics that coolant pressure returns to 0.4–0.6 MPa. Clear alarm 700016.

cause.p: Probable cause (15%): Coolant pump impeller is worn or damaged, reducing flow capacity.

remedy.cmd: Perform LOTO on the coolant pump circuit at the main electrical panel.
Drain the coolant tank into a waste container (capacity: 300 L).
Disconnect pump inlet and outlet piping, then remove the pump assembly from the tank.
Inspect the impeller for cracks, worn vanes, or foreign object damage.
remedy.info: Compare against the impeller wear limit template (see Maintenance Gauge Kit). Replace impeller if vane thickness is below 2 mm.

remedy.cmd: Reinstall or replace the pump assembly (P/N: P-1200-01), refill coolant, remove LOTO, and test.
remedy.stepresult: Pump runs without abnormal noise. Coolant pressure 0.4–0.6 MPa at 50 Hz.

cause.p: Probable cause (5%): Coolant level has dropped below the pump inlet due to evaporation, leakage, or recent maintenance without refill.

remedy.cmd: Check the coolant level sight glass on the tank. Level should be between MIN and MAX marks.
If below MIN, top up with approved coolant mixture (5–8% concentration, water-soluble).
If level drops repeatedly, inspect for leaks at all hose connections, the pump seal, and the tank itself.
